title: High Castle
summary: A mountain freehold of House Fiona.

claims.text: High Castle's dwellers opened many trods to other freeholds and welcomed any visitor who honored the fae's oaths of brotherhood with the Nunnehi.

As other Kithain holdings fell to attacks by native fae whose lands had been taken, refugees flocked there; bound by a promise not to expand outward, the Fiona dug down into the mountain, and Lord Tamlin, guided by a dream, moved the balefire to the castle's deepest heart.

title: Goblin Town
summary: A nocker freehold that rearranges itself.

claims.text: Goblin Town shifts at random, its entrances and secret passages moving so that even long-time residents get lost; this makes a fine defense, and few know all its turns, Dr. Coma, Isaac Glass and Rat Breath knowing the most.
Some nockers hint that something sinister causes the shifting, since it began only recently; every nocker childling dreams of finding an undiscovered passage and the treasure rumored within.
